body: Material: 14 screenshots and 4 screen recordings of the Dimensional personality app (@JayAfrican), 30 Oct 2026. 197 scored traits in 22 categories; levels (1 Very low to 5 Very high) measured from each tile's 5-segment bar and checked against the app's own Big Five labels; exact scores visible for Connector (93) and Love of Learning (83, average user 73); 59 traits locked (Plus). Nature of the evidence: one sitting of self-report, compared with other app users; the app's own Fluidity field marks traits as variable. Comparison screens are not part of this source record. Source call: JayArr answered 'Source' when prompted under constraint 28, 2026-10-30.
